# sspi_users (Data Source)

Lists every local and remote (LDAP) user or group known to the SSPI appliance's IAM subsystem.

Corresponds to `GET /sspi/iam/users`. Returns all results in a single page (no offset/page_size pass-through).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The users and groups known to the SSPI appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `name` (String) The user or group's name.
- `user_type` (String) `LOCAL_USER`, `REMOTE_USER`, or `REMOTE_GROUP`.
